versions.changelog: License declared as MIT-0 to match the registry. No content change.

Initial release: the decision layer for git worktrees — when to create one, not how. Covers the concurrency always-case (shared checkouts lose edits below the index, invalidating both test runs), a pre-creation blocker check for un-parameterized singletons (port / DB / container / .env), and the teardown commitment.
